player_prompt.intro:
O iko Player {player_id} ({role}) ena game ni Matching Pennies e {num_rounds}-round.
- Ena vinaka, tukuna '[heads]' se '[tails]' (se '[h]', '[t]').
- Ya kaya ni o na taura kei na nomuni vakatawa, Player 0 na wini na round; ni oti, Player 1 na wini.
Vakaraitaka na nomu chomereki ena vakadewa '[heads]' se '[tails]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Na vakadewa ni vakatotolo; kurabui '[heads]' se '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Na Dauqito 0 e digitaki {choice0}; Na Dauqito 1 e digitaki {choice1}. Veikilikili -> Na Dauqito 0 sa qai
message.round_mismatch: Na Dauqito 0 e digitaka {choice0}; Na Dauqito 1 e digitaka {choice1}. Veidalawa -> Na Dauqito 1 e qaqa.

outcome.p0_wins: Player 0 e qai wini vica na raundi.
outcome.p1_wins: Na Dauqito 1 e qaqa vica na raundi.
outcome.draw: E sega ni dua na macala e yaco ena qito.
